fields.description: The Terraces is Sobha City’s garden-villa collection in Abu Dhabi. Three- and four-bedroom homes include a separate majlis or study, with private backyards and outdoor terraces. The larger three-bedroom layouts differ substantially from the compact types, making the plan name as important as the bedroom count.

overview: Three-bedroom Type A arranges the bedrooms upstairs and places a majlis or study beside the entrance. Types C and D add more internal space and a maid’s room. The four-bedroom Type A extends to a second floor and includes a lift; these features should not be assumed for every three-bedroom home.
research.locationNote: Within Sobha City, Abu Dhabi. Property Finder places the collection in Al Bahya, also written Al Bahia. Confirm the exact villa plot or tower position on its own approved plan; community travel times are not unit-specific measurements.
research.priceNote: Sobha’s own project page lists a starting guide of AED 5.09m, subject to inventory. Property Finder’s approximately AED 5m launch guide is a different reference; request a dated quotation and complete costs for the chosen home.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% at launch, 40% during construction and 40% on handover. No dated developer-issued schedule was located in the project page or reviewed brochure. This is an attributed launch reference; obtain the current instalments, fees and deadlines in writing.
research.handoverNote: Sobha’s current catalogue lists December 2029; the reviewed villa brochure does not print a dated completion statement. Property Finder independently lists the same month. Confirm contractual delivery for the selected release.
